summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of preserving wrapper assignments when using method_decorator with partial objects, but it introduces a potential behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The use of wraps() directly on the partial object may inadvertently modify the behavior of the wrapped function, potentially breaking existing code that relies on the current behavior of method_decorator.
The PR does not include additional tests to verify that the fix does not introduce regressions or handle other edge cases involving partial objects and method_decorator.
